senses.gloss:
प्रेणा, a shortened form for प्रेम्णा, inst. of
प्रेमन्, q. v.

प्रेणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. gladdening, delighting, one
who delights (by praises); (Sāy.) = प्रेरयितृ, in-
citing, instigating.
प्रेणि प्रेणि. See p. 663, col. 1.

प्रेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who loves or cherishes,
a benefactor; (Sāy.) = तर्पयितृ.

प्रेम, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्रेमन्, love, affection,
(at the end of adj. comps.; cf. स-प्˚); (आ), f. =
प्रेमन् (in प्रेमा-बन्ध); a kind of metre
consisting of four lines (the first, second, and fourth
being ¯¯˘¯¯˘˘¯˘¯¯ and the third ˘¯˘¯¯
&c.).
—प्रेमा-बन्ध = प्रेम-बन्ध, q. v.

प्रेमन्, आ, अ, m. n. love, affection, kindness,
tender regard, favour; sport, pastime; joy, glad-
ness, pleasure; (आ), m. a jest, joke; wind, air;
an epithet of Indra; N. of various men; प्रेम्णा
(Ved. also प्रेणा), ind. through love or affection.
—प्रेम-तत्त्व-निरूपण, अम्, n., N. of a Bengālī
poem by Kṛṣṇa-dāsa.
—प्रेम-नारायण, अस्, m.,
N. of a king (= प्रेम-साहि).
—प्रेम-पर, अस्,
आ, अम्, intent on love, filled with affection, affec-
tionate, loving, constant.
—प्रेम-पातन, अम्, n.
defluxion of rheum or of tears.
—प्रेम-पात्र, अम्,
n. an object of affection, a beloved person or thing.
—प्रेम-बन्ध, अस्, m. or प्रेम-बन्धन,
अम्, n. ‘love-bond,’ the ties of love, love.
—प्रेम-
भाव, अस्, m. state of affection, love.
—प्रेम-राशी-
भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become (as
it were) one mass of affection.
—प्रेमर्द्धि (˚म-
ऋ˚), इस्, f. increase of affection, ardent love.
—प्रेम-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, full of love, affectionate; (अती), f.
a mistress.
—प्रेम-विश्वास-भूमि, इस्, f. an object
of love and confidence.
—प्रेम-सागर, अस्, m. an
ocean of love.
—प्रेम-साहि, इस्, m. (fr. प्रेमन्
+ साहि = شاه) = प्रेम-नारायण.
—प्रेमामृत
(˚म-अम्˚), अम्, n. ‘love-ambrosia,’ N. of a metrical
list of 112 names of Kṛṣṇa.
—प्रेमाश्रु (˚म-
अश्˚), उ, n. a tear of affection.
प्रेमन् प्रेमन्, &c. See p. 663, col. 1.
प्रेमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, loving, affectionate, friendly.

प्रेयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. प्रिय), dearer,
very dear, more agreeable, more desired; dearest,
most beloved; kinder, more affectionate; (आन्), m.
a lover, husband; (असी), f. a mistress, wife; (आन्, अस्),
m. n. (in rhetoric) flattery.
—प्रेयस्-कर, अस्, m. the
hand of a lover.
—प्रेयस्-ता, f. or प्रेयस्-त्व, अम्, n.
the being dearer, being very dear.
—प्रेयो-ऽपत्य,
अस्, m. ‘very fond of offspring,’ a heron.
प्रेयस् प्रेयस्. See p. 663, col. 1.

प्रेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. प्रिय), dearest,
very dear, most beloved, greatly beloved, most
agreeable, most desired; (अस्), m. a lover, husband;
(आ), f. a mistress, wife; a leg.
—प्रेष्ठ-तम,
अस्, आ, अम्, dearest, most beloved.
प्रेष्ठ प्रेष्ठ. See p. 663, col. 1.

प्रे प्रे (प्र-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. प्रैति,
प्रैतुम् (Ved. प्रेषे), to go forth, come forth,
appear (Ved.); to go on, proceed (especially as a
sacrifice, Ved.); to go forwards, go farther; to go
to, come to, arrive at, attain, reach; to go out; to
depart (this life), die: Intens. प्रेयते, Ved. to drive
or go forth (in a chariot, said of Uṣas).

प्रेत, अस्, आ, अम्, departed, deceased, dead, de-
funct, a dead person; (अस्), m. the spirit of a de-
parted person, departed spirit, spirit abiding in the
lower world, the spirit before obsequial rites are
performed; a ghost, an evil being (especially one ani-
mating the carcases of the dead).
—प्रेत-कर्मन्,
अ, n. an obsequial act or rite, funeral rites.
—प्रेत-
कल्प, अस्, m. ‘obsequial ordinance,’ N. of the
second part of the Garuḍa-Purāṇa.
—प्रेत-कार्य,
अम्, n. or प्रेत-कृत्य, अम्, आ, n. f. an obsequial
or funeral rite, obsequial ceremonies in honour of
the dead or of deceased ancestors.
—प्रेत-गत, अस्,
आ, अम्, gone to the departed, dead.
—प्रेत-गृह,
अम्, n. ‘house of the dead,’ a burying ground.
—प्रे-
त-गोप, अस्, m. the Keeper of the dead.
—प्रेत-
चारिन्, ई, m. ‘roaming among the dead,’ Śiva.
—प्रे-
त-त्व, अम्, n. the state of a departed spirit, the being
dead.
—प्रेत-दाह, अस्, m. the burning of the
dead.
—प्रेत-धूम, अस्, m. ‘smoke of the dead,’
the smoke of a funeral pile; (according to Kullūka
= दह्यमान-शव-धूम.)
—प्रेत-नदी, f.
the river of the dead (= वैतरणी, q. v.).
—प्रेत-
नर, अस्, m. a dead man, a corpse, a ghost.
—प्रेत-निर्यातक or प्रेत-निर्हारक, अस्, m. a
man employed to carry forth dead bodies; a kinsman
who does so.
—प्रेत-पक्ष or प्रेत-पक्षक,
अस्, m. ‘half-month of the departed, i. e. of the
Manes,’ N. of the dark half in the Gauṇa Āśvina
(so called as peculiarly appointed for the celebration
of obsequial rites to the Pitṛs or Manes; = पितृ-
पक्ष).
—प्रेत-पटह, अस्, m. ‘drum of the
dead,’ a drum beaten at a funeral.
—प्रेत-पति, इस्,
m. ‘lord or ruler of the dead,’ an epithet of Yama.
—प्रेत-पात्र, अम्, n. ‘vessel of the dead,’ a vessel
used in obsequial presentations.
—प्रेत-पुर, अम्,
n. the city of the dead, the abode of Yama.
—प्रेत-
प्रसाधन, अम्, n. the laying out of a corpse.
—प्रेत-भक्षिणी, f., N. of a goddess.
—प्रेत-
भाव, अस्, m. the state of the departed, the being
dead; संसिद्धः प्रेत-भावाय, ready to die.
—प्रेतभाव-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the state
[]
of the departed, dead.
—प्रेत-भूमि, इस्, f. a place
in which the dead are burned or buried, a cemetery.
—प्रेत-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a section of the Garuḍa-
Purāṇa.
—प्रेत-मेध, अस्, m. a sacrifice to the
dead, funeral sacrifice.
—प्रेत-मोक्ष, अस्, m., N.
of the twenty-eighth chapter of the Māgha-mā-
hātmya.
—प्रेत-राक्षसी, f. a various reading for
अपेत-राक्षसी, = तुलसी.
—प्रेत-राज, अस्, m.
‘king of the dead,’ an epithet of Yama.
—प्रेत-लोक,
अस्, m. the world of the dead, the region of disem-
bodied spirits (in which they remain for one year
or until the obsequial rites are completed).
—प्रेत-
वत्, ind. as if dead, as in the case of the dead.
—प्रेत-वन, अम्, n. ‘grove of the dead,’ a place
where bodies are burnt or buried, a cemetery.
—प्रे-
त-वाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled or possessed by an
evil spirit.
—प्रेत-शरीर, अम्, n. the body which
accompanies a departed spirit.
—प्रेत-शिला, f. ‘stone
of the dead,’ N. of a stone near Gayā, on which
funeral cakes were offered.
—प्रेत-शुद्धि, इस्, f.
or प्रेत-शौच, अम्, n. purification after the death
of a kinsman.
—प्रेत-श्राद्ध, अम्, n. obsequial
ceremonies offered to a departed relative during the
year of his demise (fifteen are said to be required).
—प्रेत-हार, अस्, m. one who carries out the dead,
a near kinsman.
—प्रेताधिप (˚त-अध्˚), अस्, m.
‘lord or ruler of the dead,’ an epithet of Yama.
—प्रेताधिपति (˚त-अध्˚), इस्, m., Ved. the lord of
the dead, ruler of departed spirits.
—प्रेतान्न (˚त-
अन्˚), अम्, n. food offered to the Manes or distributed
on a person's death.
—प्रेतावास (˚त-आव्˚), अस्, m.
‘habitation of the dead,’ a burial ground, cemetery.
—प्रेतास्थि (˚त-अस्˚), इ, n. the bone of a dead
man.
—प्रेतास्थि-धारिन्, ई, m. ‘wearing dead men's
bones,’ an epithet of Rudra (Śiva).
—प्रेतेश (˚त-ईश)
or प्रेतेश्वर (˚त-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of the dead,’
an epithet of Yama.
—प्रेतोद्देश (˚त-उद्˚), अस्,
m. an offering to the Manes.
प्रेत प्रेत, &c. See under प्रे, p. 663, col. 2.

प्रेति, इस्, f., Ved. departure, flight.
—प्रेति-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the word प्रेति or a
form of प्रे.
—प्रेतीषणि (˚ति-इष्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved.
striving to move forwards (an epithet of Agni; Sāy.
= प्राप्त-गमन).

प्रेतिक, अस्, m. the soul of a deceased person, a
spirit, ghost.

प्रेत्य, ind. having departed, having died, after
death, in the next world, in the life to come.
—प्रेत्य-जाति, इस्, f. rank or position in the world
to come.
—प्रेत्य-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, obtaining after
death, enjoying the fruits of anything in the next
world.
—प्रेत्य-भाव, अस्, m. the state after death,
condition of the soul after death, future state.
—प्रे-
त्यभाविक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the state after
death, (opposed to ऐहलौकिक; probably an incor-
rect form for प्रैत्यभाविक.)

प्रेत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, straying about (as cattle); (आ),
m. wind, air; an epithet of Indra; [cf. प्रेर्त्वन्.]

प्रेहि-कटा, f. (प्रेहि, 2nd sing. impv. of प्रे +
कट), a rite in which no mats are allowed (see
Gaṇa Mayūra-vyaṃsakādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 72).
प्रेहिकटा प्रेहि-कटा, &c. See p. 663, col. 3.

प्रेहि-कर्दमा, f. a rite in which no impurity
of any kind is allowed.

प्रेहि-द्वितीया, f. a rite at which no second person
is allowed to be present.

प्रेहि-वाणिजा, f. a rite at which no merchants are
allowed to be present.

प्रेकीय प्रेकीय (fr. प्र + एक), Nom. P. प्रे-
कीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रैकीय; see Vopa-deva II. 4.

प्रेक्ष् प्रेक्ष् (प्र-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. प्रेक्षते,
प्रेक्षितुम्, to look towards, look at, view, see,
behold, regard, observe; to look on (without inter-
fering), allow, suffer.

प्रेक्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, looking at, viewing,
beholding, seeing, surveying, intending to view;
(अस्), m. a looker, spectator, beholder, surveyor,
member of an audience.
—प्रेक्षकेरित (˚क-ईर्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, uttered by a spectator.

प्रेक्षण, अम्, n. looking at, viewing, seeing,
regarding, being a spectator; visiting; looking wan-
tonly; the eye; any public show or spectacle; a
[]
sight; a place where public exhibitions are held.
—प्रेक्षण-कूट, अस्, अम्, m. n. the eye-ball, the
pupil of the eye.

प्रेक्षणक, अस्, इका, अम्, looking at, viewing,
a spectator; (अम्), n. a spectacle, show, a play.

प्रेक्षणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, looking at, one who looks
at or views; (आ), f. a woman fond of seeing shows.

प्रेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen or viewed,
to be beheld or gazed at, visible, apparent, conspi-
cuous [cf. दुष्-प्˚]; worth seeing, worthy of being
looked at, beautiful to the view, sightly; to be re-
garded as, resembling, looking or appearing like.
—प्रेक्षणीय-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most worthy of
being seen, most sightly.
—प्रेक्षणीय-तर, अस्,
आ, अम्, more worthy of being seen, more sightly,
more conspicuous.
—प्रेक्षणीय-ता, f. sightliness,
conspicuousness, beautifulness.

प्रेक्षणीयक, अस्, इका, अम्, visible, apparent,
conspicuous; (अम्), n. a play, spectacle.

प्रेक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking at, beholding,
regarding, observing.

प्रेक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, looking on,
viewing, beholding, regarding.

प्रेक्षा, f. looking at, viewing, beholding, ob-
serving, seeing, regarding, (sometimes at the end of
a comp., e. g. धर्म-प्रेक्ष, regarding or con-
sidering the law; cf. मुख-प्˚); sight, view, look,
aspect, appearance; being a spectator, seeing a play
or dance; any public show or spectacle, a sight; a
play, dancing; conceiving, conception, understand-
ing, intellect; circumspection, consideration; reflec-
tion, deliberation; the branch of a tree.
—प्रेक्षा-
गार (˚षा-अग्˚ or ˚षा-आग्˚), अस्, अम्, m. n. or
प्रेक्षा-गृह, अम्, n. ‘spectacle-house,’ any build-
ing erected for a show, temporary structure consisting
of stalls for spectators, a play-house.
—प्रेक्षा-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of circumspection, considerate,
wise, prudent.
—प्रेक्षा-समाज, अस्, m. an assembly
at a spectacle, crowd at a theatre; (according to
Kullūka = नृत्यादि-स्थान-जन-समृद्धि.)

प्रेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, viewed, beheld,
seen; (अम्), n. a look, glance.

प्रेक्षितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who looks on, a
spectator.

1. प्रेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at, to be
regarded or observed [cf. दुष्-प्˚]; to be seen,
visible, apparent, brilliantly conspicuous; to be looked
at patiently, to be suffered or endured; worthy of being
seen, sightly, conspicuous; N. of a Śabdālaṅkāra.

2. प्रेक्ष्य, ind. having looked at, having beheld
or observed.

प्रेक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being looked at or
beheld, being seen.

प्रेङ्ख् प्रेङ्ख् (प्र-ईङ्ख्), cl. 1. P. प्रेङ्खति,
प्रेङ्खितुम्, to tremble, shake, quiver, oscillate,
vibrate: Caus. प्रेङ्खयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
oscillate or vibrate, swing (trans.), shake.

प्रेङ्ख, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, shaking, vibrating,
oscillating, swinging (Ved.); (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n.
a swing, a sort of hammock or swinging cot (either
for travelling or diversion); नकुलस्य वामदे-
वस्य प्रेङ्खः and मरुताम् प्रेङ्खः, N. of
two Sāmans; (आ), f. dancing; wandering, travelling
about, roaming (?); a particular pace of a horse.
—प्रेङ्खेङ्खन (˚ख-ईङ्˚), अम्, n. swinging.

प्रेङ्खण, अस्, आ, अम्, wandering, moving or
going towards, entering; (अम्), n. swinging; a swing;
a minor drama in one act; going, wandering (?).
—प्रेङ्खण-कारिका, f. a female swinger or dancer.

प्रेङ्खणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be swung or made
to oscillate.
प्रेङ्खयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, swinging (trans.).

प्रेङ्खित, अस्, आ, अम्, swung, shaken, set in
motion, made to oscillate; being in contact with (?).

प्रेङ्खोलन, अम्, n. swinging, shaking, oscil-
lating; a swing, swing-cot or hammock.

प्रेङ्खोलय, Nom. P. प्रेङ्खोलयति, -यितुम्,
to swing, shake; [cf. अन्दोलय, आन्दोलय, हिन्दो-
लय.]

प्रेङ्गण प्रेङ्गण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. इङ्ग् with
प्र), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 32.

प्रेड् प्रेड् (प्र-ईड्), cl. 2. A. प्रेट्टे, प्रेडितुम्,
Ved. to implore, supplicate; praise, celebrate; (Sāy.
= प्रकर्षेण स्तु, to praise greatly, celebrate ex-
ceedingly.)

प्रेडक प्रेडक, an incorrect form for प्रे-
रक, q. v.

प्रेद्ध प्रेद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. इन्ध् with
प्र), Ved. kindled, lighted.

प्रेन् प्रेन् (प्र-इन्), cl. 8. P. प्रेनोति, &c.,
Ved. to send forth, impel forwards or upwards.

प्रेन्वन प्रेन्वन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. इन्व् with
प्र), see Vārttika II. to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 2.
प्रेन्वनीय, see Vārttika II. to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 2.

प्रेप्सा प्रेप्सा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. आप् with
प्र), the wish to attain, desire of obtaining, desire,
longing for; supposition, assumption.

प्रेर् प्रेर् (प्र-ईर्), cl. 2. A. प्रेर्ते, प्रेरि-
तुम्, to move, come forward, come forth, go forth,
rise, appear (Ved.): Caus. P. प्रेरयति, -यितुम्,
to set in motion, cause to move forwards, move; to
drive forwards, push on, drive onwards, urge or
press forwards; to urge on, force on, hasten, stimu-
late, incite, excite; to send forth, dismiss, dispatch;
to send; to direct towards; to utter; to ask.

प्रेरक, अस्, इका, अम्, setting in motion, urging
on, impelling, inciting, stimulating, exciting; sending.
—प्रेरक-त्व, अम्, n. the act of setting in motion,
urging on.

प्रेरण, अम्, n. driving on [cf. पशु-प्˚]; (अम्,
आ), n. f. the act of urging on, inciting, driving,
instigating; impulse, passion; sending, dispatching,
directing, ordering, order, direction, commanding;
activity, action; the sense of the causal verb, [cf.
Vopa-deva XVIII. 1.]
—प्रेरणार्थ (˚ण-अर्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, having the sense of inciting or of the
causal verb.
प्रेरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be urged on or incited.

प्रेरयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, setting in motion, mov-
ing, directing (the eyes).

प्रेरयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who urges, an insti-
gator, inciting, instigating; one who sends.

प्रेरितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who urges on or incites,
an inciter; one who sends.

प्रेर्त्वन्, आ, m., Ved. the ocean, the sea; (अरी),
f. a river.

प्रेर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being urged on, being
incited.

प्रेष् 1. प्रेष्, cl. 1. A. प्रेषते, &c., to
go, move; (also read ह्रेष्.)

प्रेष् 2. प्रेष् (प्र-इष्, see rt. 1. इष्),
cl. 4. P. A. प्रेष्यति, -ते, प्रेषितुम्, to drive
forth, drive away, drive forwards, drive on; to
send forth, send out, utter; to hurl, fling, cast; (P.)
to call upon, invite, summon (in Vedic ritual said
technically of the presiding priest at a sacrifice calling
upon the assistant priests to commence a recitation
or a ceremony; with acc. of the object, e. g. साम
प्रेष्यति गाय ब्रूहीति वा, he calls upon an
assistant priest with the words ‘Sing’ or ‘Say’ to
commence the recitation of a Sāman; also with gen.
of the object; also with dat. of the deity to whom
the recitation is addressed or the sacrifice offered,
e. g. अग्नये प्रेष्य, call upon an assistant priest
to commence the offering or to commence the
hymn to Agni); Caus. प्रेषयति, -यितुम्, to send
forth, send away, dismiss; to send into exile, banish;
to send, dispatch; to send word to, send a message
to; to hurl, fling, cast, throw; to turn or direct
(the eyes).

3. प्रेष्, ट्, f., Ved. pressing, pressure; (ट्, ट्, ट्),
pressing, urging on, (Sāy. = प्रेरक.)

प्रेष, अस्, m. urging on, impelling (Ved. =
प्रैष); pain, affliction.

प्रेषक, अस्, इका, अम्, sending, dispatching; one
who orders or commands, ordering, directing.

प्रेषण, अम्, n. the act of sending, dispatching
(a messenger); sending on a mission, commissioning,
charging, ordering, directing, commanding; execut-
ing a commission.
—प्रेषण-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, executing
a commission.
—प्रेषणाध्यक्ष (˚ण-अध्˚),
अस्, m. a superintendent of the commands (of a
king), chief of the administration.
प्रेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent or dispatched.

प्रेषयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sending forth, sending
away; turning, directing (the eyes).

प्रेषयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, sending on a commis-
sion, giving orders.

प्रेषितवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has sent or
dispatched.

प्रेषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be called upon
or invited (to commence a ceremony).

प्रेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent or dispatched,
proper to be sent [cf. कार्य-प्˚]; (अस्), m. a mes-
senger, servant, menial, slave [cf. ग्राम-प्˚]; (आ),
f. a female messenger, female servant; (अम्), n. the
being a servant, servitude; [cf. शूद्र-प्˚.]
—प्रेष्य-
कर, अस्, ई, अम्, executing orders.
—प्रेष्य-जन,
अस्, m. servants collectively, domestics, an establishment
of servants.
—प्रेष्य-ता, f. or प्रेष्य-त्व, अम्,
n. the being a servant, servitude.
—प्रेष्य-भाव,
अस्, m. the state or condition of a servant, servitude.
—प्रेष्य-वधू, ऊस्, f. a female servant, hand-
maid; the wife of a slave.
—प्रेष्य-वर्ग, अस्, m.
a train of servants.
—प्रेष्या-त्व, अम्, n. the state
of a female servant, being a handmaid.

प्रेष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being sent forth, being
sent or dispatched (on an errand).

प्रेहण प्रेहण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ईह् with प्र),
see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 31.
